say:1:1033517001:1.text: And we thank you for your assistance, Magister.
say:1:1033517001:1.source_cn: 感谢你的援手，魔法师<male>先生</male><f...
say:1:1033517001:1.male: And we thank you for your assistance, Magister.
say:1:1033517001:1.female: And we thank you for your assistance, Magister.

say:2:1033517002:1.text: Granny Dahnie was right. You truly are someone we can trust.
say:2:1033517002:1.source_cn: 达赫妮贤者判断的没有错，你果然是值得信赖的人。
say:2:1033517002:1.male: Granny Dahnie was right. You truly are someone we can trust.
say:2:1033517002:1.female: Granny Dahnie was right. You truly are someone we can trust.

say:3:1033517003:1.text: We'll be watching over the Lucent Tree, waiting eagerly for good news from the Vaduso Mountains.
say:3:1033517003:1.source_cn: 我们会守护着流荧树，等候从瓦度索山脉传来你们的好消息。
say:3:1033517003:1.male: We'll be watching over the Lucent Tree, waiting eagerly for good news from the Vaduso Mountains.
say:3:1033517003:1.female: We'll be watching over the Lucent Tree, waiting eagerly for good news from the Vaduso Mountains.
